name: get_selection
description: Get the selected nodes: the place to start when the user points at layers. Returns each selected node with its direct children by default; children past the depth are counted as childCount. Use get_node or describe for deeper branches.

depth.description: Levels of children to include (0 = selected nodes only). Default: 1

name: get_node
description: Get detailed properties of a node by ID. Use depth to limit child recursion (0 = node only, 1 = direct children, etc). Default: unlimited.

depth.description: Max depth of children to include (0 = no children). Default: unlimited

name: find_nodes
description: Find nodes by name pattern and/or type.

name: get_jsx
description: Get JSX representation of a node and its children. Compact round-trip format — same syntax as the render tool. JSX longer than 12000 characters is outlined: layers below the depth that fits are written with keepChildren and a comment naming their id, to read with get_jsx; render the JSX with replace_id on this node and those layers keep their children.

name: render
description: Render JSX to design nodes. Draw a shape of your own as one layer with <Vector d="M2 12 L22 12" stroke="#000" />, styled like any layer; inline <svg> is for artwork copied from elsewhere and draws its shapes, without its text. Use replace_id to replace a placeholder while preserving its position, or to edit a layer in place from its get_jsx: it keeps its id, and layers written with keepChildren keep their children.

replace_id.description: Node ID to replace — new node takes its position in parent, old node is deleted

parent_id.description: Parent node ID to render into

insert_index.description: Position among siblings (0 = first child). Omit to append at end.

x.description: X position of the root node (-1000000 to 1000000)

y.description: Y position of the root node (-1000000 to 1000000)

name: update_node
description: Update properties of an existing node: position, size, rotation, opacity, corner radius, visibility, lock, name, text, font.

flow_direction.description: Auto-layout flow direction for FRAME nodes

name: set_layout
description: Set auto-layout (flexbox) on a frame. Direction, alignment, spacing, padding.

spacing.description: Gap between items (only changes if provided) (0 to 100000)

padding.description: Equal padding on all sides (only changes if provided) (0 to 100000)

align.description: Primary axis alignment (only changes if provided)

counter_align.description: Cross axis alignment (only changes if provided)

flow_direction.description: Child flow direction for auto-layout. AUTO inherits from parent.

name: set_layout_child
description: Configure auto-layout child: sizing (FIXED/HUG/FILL), grow, alignment, absolute positioning.

grow.description: Flex grow factor (0 = fixed, 1 = grow) (0 to 1000)

positioning.description: ABSOLUTE to take node out of auto-layout flow

name: set_radius
description: Set corner radius. Use individual corners for independent values.

radius.description: Corner radius for all corners (0 to 1000000)

name: set_fill
description: Set fill on a node. Solid: color="#ff0000". Linear gradient: gradient="top-bottom" or "left-right" with color (start) and color_end (end).

color_end.description: End color for gradient (if omitted, solid fill)

name: set_stroke
description: Set the stroke (border) of a node.

name: set_text
description: Set text content of a text node. With markdown, the text is Markdown: # and ## headings, **bold**, *italic*, ~~strike~~, `code`, [links](url), lists, and > quotes become styled ranges and paragraphs over the text's own style.

name: set_text_properties
description: Set text layout properties: alignment, auto-resize, text case, decoration, truncation.

name: delete_nodes
description: Delete nodes by ID. Nothing is deleted unless every node exists.

name: reparent_node
description: Move a node into a different parent.

name: batch_update
description: Execute multiple modifications in one call, all or nothing: if any operation names a missing node or an invalid prop, nothing changes. Each operation is {id, props} where props can include: spacing, padding, padding_horizontal, padding_vertical, align, counter_align, sizing_horizontal, sizing_vertical, grow, name, visible, corner_radius, opacity, auto_resize, direction. Runs all updates with one layout recompute.

name: search_stock_photos
description: Search stock photos and apply to leaf image placeholders or closed area geometry. Pass a JSON array; each item is {id, query, index?, orientation?}. Containers with content, text, lines, and structural nodes are rejected.

name: describe
description: Semantic description of one or more nodes. Pass `id` for a single node, or `ids` for multiple nodes in one call. Omit depth for auto — adapts to subtree size (small block → deeper, large page → shallower).

ids.description: Node IDs (multiple nodes in one call)

name: diff_nodes
description: Patch that turns one node tree into another, as JSX attribute changes per node plus moved, added, and removed children. Children are matched by name. Apply it to the first tree with apply_patch.

name: diff_pixels
description: Pixel diff between two rendered nodes. Returns a PNG with changed pixels in red over a faded copy of the source, the changed pixel ratio, and the changed region in source-node coordinates. Use it to confirm an edit only touched the intended area.

scale.description: Export scale multiplier before the maximum-edge limit is applied (default: 1)

maxEdge.description: Maximum output width or height in pixels. Preserves aspect ratio and never upscales. Defaults to 1280 for bounded model input.

threshold.description: Per-pixel color tolerance from 0 to 1; smaller is stricter (default: 0.1)

name: zoom_to_fit
description: Scroll and zoom the view so the given layers fit in it, zooming in no further than 100%. The layers must be on the current page.

ids.description: Node IDs to fit in view

name: get_page_tree
description: Get the node tree of the current page. Returns lightweight hierarchy: id, type, name, size, and text for TEXT nodes. Use depth, root_id, or node_types to keep large pages small. Use get_node for full properties of a specific node.

depth.description: Max nesting depth to return (1 = returned root nodes only). Default: unlimited

root_id.description: Return only this node subtree instead of the whole current page

node_types.description: Keep only these node types and their ancestors, for example FRAME or TEXT

name: get_current_page
description: Get the current page name and ID.

name: list_pages
description: List all pages in the document.

name: set_selection
description: Select one or more nodes by ID.

name: query_nodes
list_components
description: List reusable components from the document and enabled component libraries, optionally filtered by name.

library_id.description: Filter library components by library ID

name: insert_library_component
description: Insert a reusable component from an enabled library by stable library and asset identity.

variant_values.description: Optional JSON object of variant property values

name: switch_page
description: Switch to a different page by name or ID.

name: get_bounds
description: Get a node's absolute bounding box, or without an ID the box around everything on the current page.

id.description: Node ID; the current page when left out

name: list_comments
description: Read the comments people left on the canvas, oldest first: each thread with its text, author, page, the layer it is pinned to, its position, replies, and whether it is resolved. Open threads only unless includeResolved is set. Use it to find review feedback to act on, then reply_to_comment and resolve_comment.

page.description: Only threads on this page ID

author.description: Only threads this person started or replied to

name: add_comment
description: Leave a comment on the canvas, as a person does with the Comment tool: pinned on a layer by ID, which it then follows, or at x, y on a page. Text may use Markdown: **bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~, [links](https://…), and - or 1. lists.

node.description: Layer ID to pin the comment on

page.description: Page ID without a layer; the current page if omitted

x.description: Canvas X, or offset from the layer’s left edge

y.description: Canvas Y, or offset from the layer’s top edge

author.description: Name shown as the author, such as your agent's name; "Agent" if omitted

name: reply_to_comment
description: Answer a comment thread by ID from list_comments, for example to say what you changed. A reply reopens a resolved thread. Text may use Markdown, as in add_comment.

author.description: Name shown as the author, such as your agent's name; "Agent" if omitted

name: resolve_comment
description: Mark a comment thread by ID as resolved once its feedback is addressed, which hides it from the canvas and the open list; pass resolved: false to reopen it.

resolved.description: false reopens the thread; true by default

name: list_statuses
description: Read the document’s statuses, such as Draft, In review or Ready for dev, and the layers that show one: sections, frames, components and instances, with their page. Use it to find what is ready to build or still in review, and set_status to change one.

status.description: Only layers with this status name

name: set_status
description: Give a section, frame, component or instance one of the document’s statuses by name, as list_statuses lists them, or clear its status with null. Only layers directly on a page or in a section take one.

status.description: A status name from list_statuses, or null to clear it

name: get_font_status
description: Report whether fonts used on the current page are faithfully available. Returns requested faces, their loaded source, active substitutions, why an installed face could not be loaded, and affected nodes.

name: list_available_fonts
description: List font families the host can render: installed, bundled, and online families. Use this to discover what fonts are available to set on a text node — distinct from get_font_status, which reports the faces used on the page.

name: create_shape
description: Create a shape on the canvas. Use FRAME for containers/cards, RECTANGLE for solid blocks, ELLIPSE for circles, TEXT for labels, LINE for rules and dividers, STAR for starbursts and badges, POLYGON for triangles and regular polygons, and SECTION for page sections. Use create_vector with an SVG path for arbitrary shapes.

x.description: X position in the parent, or on the page (-1000000 to 1000000)

y.description: Y position in the parent, or on the page (-1000000 to 1000000)

name.description: Node name shown in layers panel

parent_id.description: Parent node ID to nest inside

name: search_icons
description: Search Iconify for icons by keyword. Accepts multiple queries — all searched in parallel. Returns results keyed by query.

name: insert_icon
description: Insert one or more vector icons onto the canvas. Pass a single name or multiple names to batch-insert into the same parent. If already cached by get_icons — instant, no network request.

name.description: Single icon name (shorthand for names with one icon)

parent_id.description: Parent node ID for all icons

options.description: How sets drawn from their own sources draw the icons; other sets ignore it. Material Symbols (material-symbols-outlined, -rounded, -sharp): wght 100–700, FILL 0 or 1, GRAD -50–200, opsz 20–48 (follows size when left out). SF Symbols (sf-symbols, macOS desktop only): weight ultralight…black, scale small|medium|large, rendering monochrome|hierarchical|palette|multicolor, variable 0–1 for symbols with variable color, and secondary and tertiary as #rrggbb for palette. E.g. {"wght":600,"FILL":1}

name: get_icons
description: Pre-fetch icons from Iconify into cache. Batches by prefix (one HTTP request per set). Call this once with all needed icons, then use insert_icon to place them instantly. Popular sets: lucide (outline), mdi (filled), heroicons, tabler, solar, mingcute, ri (remix).

name: combine_as_variants
description: Combine components sharing a parent into a component set (variant set). Components named as Figma names variants, "State=On, Size=Large", get those variant properties; names like "Button/Primary" derive a Variant property from the segments after the first slash.

name: create_instance
description: Create an instance of a component.

name: expose_instance_swap
description: Expose nested instances as an instance-swap slot on their component.

name: create_slot
description: Make a frame inside a main component a slot, as Create slot does: instances can then hold their own content in it, and a behaviour can bind it as a part. Returns the slot name.

id.description: Frame ID inside a main component

name: get_behaviour
description: Read the behaviour of a main component, component set, or variant by property and slot names, with the required values and parts still missing. Without an ID, list every behaviour kind with the values and parts it binds.

name: set_behaviour
description: Make a main component or set behave as a Reka UI control in preview and code, by its own property and slot names: e.g. { kind: "switch", values: { value: "State" }, parts: { thumb: "Thumb" }, states: "Interaction" }. On/off variant values are guessed from names like On and Off unless given as { property, on, off }. null removes it. Returns the behaviour and what it still misses; get_behaviour lists every kind.

id.description: Main component or component set ID; a variant uses its set

behaviour.description: The behaviour by property and slot names, or null to remove it

name: create_page
description: Create a new page.

name: create_vector
description: Create a vector node from SVG path data or a VectorNetwork.

x.description: X position in the parent, or on the page (-1000000 to 1000000)

y.description: Y position in the parent, or on the page (-1000000 to 1000000)

path.description: SVG path data (preferred, e.g. "M0 0 L100 0 L50 80 Z") or VectorNetwork JSON, e.g. {"vertices":[{"x":0,"y":0},{"x":10,"y":0}],"segments":[{"start":0,"end":1}],"regions":[]}

name: create_slice
description: Create a slice (export region) on the canvas.

x.description: X position in the parent, or on the page (-1000000 to 1000000)

y.description: Y position in the parent, or on the page (-1000000 to 1000000)

name: create_connector
description: Create a FigJam-style connector between two layers, or from or to a point on the page; it follows the layers it joins and is deleted with them. Give each end a node id (and optionally a magnet), or x/y for a free end.

id.description: Node ID the start attaches to

magnet.description: AUTO picks the nearest side; straight lines use CENTER

x.description: Page X of a free end (-1000000 to 1000000)

y.description: Page Y of a free end (-1000000 to 1000000)

id.description: Node ID the end attaches to

magnet.description: AUTO picks the nearest side; straight lines use CENTER

x.description: Page X of a free end (-1000000 to 1000000)

y.description: Page Y of a free end (-1000000 to 1000000)

end_cap.description: Cap at the end; an arrow by default

name: import_svg
description: Import SVG markup as editable layers, as pasting it into Figma does: a frame (a group without width, height, or viewBox) with a group per <g>, a vector per shape, a text per <text>, named by id, and mask groups for clipping. Supports shapes, <tspan> styles, inherited attributes, opacity, transforms, gradients, clip paths, and internal <use>.

name.description: Name for the created frame or group (default: the root <svg> id, else "Frame" or "Group")

name: import_mermaid
description: Import a Mermaid flowchart (`flowchart` or `graph`) as FigJam layers laid out without overlaps: nodes as shapes with text, subgraphs as sections, edges as elbowed connectors with their arrowheads, line style, and label. classDef, class, and style colours carry over. Without x and y it goes to the right of what the parent holds. Returns the layer id of every node, subgraph, and edge by Mermaid id.

mermaid.description: Mermaid flowchart source (e.g. "flowchart LR\n  A[Start] --> B{Ready?}")

x.description: X of the diagram’s left edge

y.description: Y of the diagram’s top edge

name: set_effects
description: Set effects on a node (drop shadow, inner shadow, blur). Pass an array or a single effect.

name: set_font
description: Set font properties of a text node.

variations.description: Variable font axis values by OpenType tag (e.g. {"wght": 550, "wdth": 75}); axes left out keep the style's values. Without a style, the nearest named style is picked.

name: set_constraints
description: Set resize constraints for a node within its parent.

name: set_size_limits
description: Set min/max width and height constraints on a node.

name: set_text_range
description: Set font properties for a text range.

variations.description: Variable font axis values by OpenType tag (e.g. {"wght": 550, "wdth": 75}); axes left out keep the style's values. Without a style, the nearest named style is picked.

name: set_blend_mode
description: Set blend mode of a node.

name: set_image_fill
description: Set an image fill on a node from Base64-encoded image data or a data URL.

image_data.description: Image bytes (PNG, JPEG, or WEBP) as Base64 or a data URL

name: clone_nodes
description: Clone (duplicate) nodes, each beside its original.

name: group_nodes
description: Group selected nodes.

name: ungroup_nodes
description: Ungroup groups, keeping their children in place.

name: flatten_nodes
description: Flatten nodes into a single vector.

name: convert_to_components
description: Convert one or more frames/groups into components.

name: get_ancestors
description: Get the ancestor chain from a node to the page root.

name: get_bindings
description: Get variable bindings for a node.

name: replace_node
description: Replace a node with JSX content.

name: arrange
description:
Arrange layers so they stop overlapping or follow a structure. Modes:
- spread (default): push overlapping layers apart, each staying near where it was.
- compact: spread, then close the gaps.
- pack: rows in order, like a page of screens or components.
- grid, row, column: in order from the first layer; grid takes cols.
- flow: ranks along connectors, rerouting elbowed ones; flowcharts, pipelines, state machines.
- tree: from its roots along connectors; sitemaps, org charts.
- radial: a tree in rings; mind maps.
- network: joined layers near each other; relationship maps.
Connectors between the layers are found automatically. A section given with all its children is laid out inside; a section alone moves as one box. Layers outside chosen sections must share a parent. The top-left corner stays put.

ids.description: Layer IDs to arrange (default: every top-level layer on the current page)

direction.description: Direction of a flow or tree: top to bottom (default), bottom to top, left to right, right to left

cols.description: Column count for grid mode (default: auto)

name: list_variables
description: List design variables (colors, numbers, strings, booleans), optionally by name.

name: list_collections
description: List all variable collections.

name: get_variable
description: Get a variable by ID.

name: create_variable
description: Create a new variable in a collection.

value.description: Initial value (hex for COLOR, number for FLOAT, etc.)

name: set_variable
description: Set the value of a variable for a specific mode.

value.description: Value (hex for COLOR, number for FLOAT, etc.)

name: delete_variable
description: Delete a variable.

name: bind_variable
description: Bind a variable to a node property, or unbind it with a null variable_id.

field.description: Field path. COLOR: "fills/0/color", "strokes/0/color", "effects/0/color". FLOAT: opacity, width, height, x, y, rotation, cornerRadius, topLeftRadius, topRightRadius, bottomLeftRadius, bottomRightRadius, fontSize, letterSpacing, lineHeight, itemSpacing, counterAxisSpacing, paddingLeft/Right/Top/Bottom, strokeWeight, borderTopWeight, borderBottomWeight, borderLeftWeight, borderRightWeight, minWidth, maxWidth, minHeight, maxHeight, gridRowGap, gridColumnGap, "effects/0/radius", "effects/0/spread", "effects/0/offsetX", "effects/0/offsetY" (a blur binds only radius). STRING: fontFamily. STRING or FLOAT: text, a number shown as text. BOOLEAN or STRING: visible, where text shows the layer unless empty, "false", "no", or "off".

variable_id.description: Variable ID, or null to unbind

name: set_variable_mode
description: Show layers in a mode of a variable collection, such as a frame in the Dark mode of a "Theme" collection, as the Appearance panel does. Children inherit the mode unless they set their own. Pass mode null to clear it, so the layers inherit their parent’s mode again.

collection.description: Variable collection ID or name, such as "Theme"

mode.description: Mode ID or name, such as "Dark"; null inherits the parent’s mode

name: get_variable_modes
description: Get the mode a layer shows for each variable collection, such as its theme: its own, or inherited from its parent or the page when inherited is true.

name: get_collection
description: Get a variable collection by ID.

name: create_collection
description: Create a new variable collection.

name: delete_collection
description: Delete a variable collection and all its variables.

name: boolean
description: Combine two or more nodes into a boolean group: union, subtract (the first minus the rest), intersect, or exclude.

ids.description: Node IDs, first one on top

name: get_path
description: Get vector path data of a node.

name: set_path
description: Set vector path data on a node. Provide a VectorNetwork JSON.

name: transform_path
description: Scale, flip, or move a vector node's path points, in that order, without changing the node's box.

scale.description: Scale factor from the centre, e.g. 2

name: get_viewport
description: Get current viewport position and zoom level.

name: set_viewport
description: Set viewport position and zoom.

name: export_svg
description: Export nodes as SVG markup. Returns the SVG string, and `warnings` naming each effect SVG cannot draw, such as glass, which the SVG leaves out.

ids.description: Node IDs to export. Omit to export all top-level nodes on the current page.

name: export_pdf
description: Export nodes as a vector PDF document, with selectable text and sharp paths. Returns base64-encoded PDF data and the size of each PDF page. Pages are drawn as the canvas draws them, with the fonts the text uses embedded; blurs, shadows, and shader fills are drawn as images.

ids.description: Node IDs to export. Omit to export all top-level nodes on the current page.

mode.description: single: one PDF page for all ids. frames: one per id, or per top-level frame of the current page. pages: one per design page

page_ids.description: mode "pages": the design pages to export, in order (default: all pages)

name: export_image
description: Export nodes as a raster image (PNG, JPG, or WEBP). Returns base64-encoded image data. Use to visually verify designs.

ids.description: Node IDs to export. Omit to export all top-level nodes on the current page.

scale.description: Export scale multiplier before the maximum-edge limit is applied (default: 1)

maxEdge.description: Maximum output width or height in pixels. Preserves aspect ratio and never upscales. Defaults to 1280 for bounded model input.

name: analyze_colors
description: Analyze color palette usage across the current page. Shows frequency, variable bindings, and optionally clusters similar colors.

show_similar.description: Include similar-color clusters for potential merging

name: analyze_typography
description: Analyze typography usage across the current page. Shows font families, sizes, weights, and their frequencies.

name: lint
description: Check the design for accessibility and consistency issues: low text contrast, small touch targets and text, off-scale spacing and radius, colors that match a variable but are not bound, and structure hygiene. Findings are sorted by severity. A `fix` is safe to apply with lint_fix; `suggestions` change values and need judgment.

ids.description: Layers to check, with their descendants (default: the current page)

preset.description: Rule preset: recommended (default), strict, or accessibility (contrast, touch targets, text size)

rules.description: Check only these rules of the preset

name: lint_fix
description: Apply lint fixes: bind colors to the variable they match and round geometry to whole pixels. With suggestions: true, also apply each finding’s first suggestion (snap radius and spacing to the scale, raise text to the minimum size, convert groups to frames, delete hidden layers). Returns what was applied and what remains.

ids.description: Layers to check, with their descendants (default: the current page)

preset.description: Rule preset: recommended (default), strict, or accessibility (contrast, touch targets, text size)

rules.description: Check only these rules of the preset

suggestions.description: Also apply the first suggestion of each finding

name: analyze_spacing
description: Analyze spacing values (gap, padding) across the current page. Checks grid compliance.

grid.description: Base grid size to check against (default: 8)

name: analyze_clusters
description: Find repeated design patterns (potential components). Groups nodes by structural signature — type, size, and child structure.

min_count.description: Min instances to form a cluster (default: 2)

name: analyze_overlaps
description: Detect visual overlaps and layout overflows on the current page, such as content covering a footer, text bleeding out of its frame, or siblings overlapping by accident.

category.description: Comma-separated categories: sibling-overlap, parent-overflow, overlay (default: all)

min_area.description: Minimum overlap area in square pixels (default: 0)

min_ratio.description: Minimum overlap ratio relative to the smaller node, 0.0–1.0 (default: 0)

include_hidden.description: Include hidden nodes in the analysis

include_locked.description: Include locked nodes in the analysis

include_absolute.description: Include absolutely-positioned nodes in the analysis

page.description: Limit analysis to nodes on the named page

page_id.description: Limit analysis to nodes on the page with this stable ID (takes precedence over page)

type.description: Comma-separated node types to analyze, e.g. FRAME,TEXT

name: preview_patch
description: Preview setting JSX attributes on a node, without changing it. Returns the patch, which apply_patch applies.

attributes.description: JSX attributes to set, named as the JSX export writes them. Example: w={200} bg="#FF0000" opacity={0.5}

name: apply_patch
description: Apply a patch from diff_nodes, preview_patch, or diff_changes. Each node must still have the patch's old values unless force is set, and nothing changes unless every hunk applies. Use dryRun to check first.

patch.description: Patch text from diff_nodes, preview_patch, or diff_changes

dryRun.description: Check and report changes without applying

force.description: Apply even when current values differ from the patch

name: export_design_tokens
description: Write the document variables as CSS custom properties: defaults in :root, other modes under their selector or @media query, aliases as var(). tailwind puts Tailwind v4 namespaces (--color-*, --spacing-*, …) in @theme with a @custom-variant per mode. dtcg returns W3C design token files instead, one per collection mode with text and effect styles and a resolver; collection and type filters do not apply. Issues lists what could not be written.

format.description: css: :root and mode scopes; tailwind: @theme, mode scopes and variants; dtcg: W3C design token files

name: import_design_tokens
description: Import W3C design token (DTCG) files as variables, and typography and shadow tokens as text and effect styles. Pass each file with its path: a file per mode in folders (as Figma exports), a .resolver.json with its files, or a Tokens Studio file with $themes. Same-named collections, modes, and variables are updated; nothing is deleted. Returns what was added, updated, and skipped and why.

files.description: Token files, each with its path (folders name collections) and JSON text

add_missing.description: Add tokens that match no variable

name: export_component_map
description: Analyze the document and return a structured component decomposition: components (with variants, props, instance counts), screens, and a dependency overview.

page.description: Page name to analyze (default: current page)
